name: JIT Compilation Pipeline
aliases: JIT Compilation Pipeline — Dr.Jit Compilation Pipeline
definition: A hybrid system that ingests computation using tracing but generates kernels that preserve the control flow (loops, subroutines) of the original program, resembling source transformation output.
summary: The JIT Compilation Pipeline captures code into an IR for machine code generation, distinguishing itself by generating indirect calls to subroutines rather than merging functions into large kernels.
